Mom, everything I am started with you. Every lesson, every sacrifice, every time you pushed me to be better — I carry all of it. You gave me the work ethic that built my career, the faith that kept me going through hard times, and a love I could always come home to.

Watching you show up for our family the way you always have — it doesn't go unnoticed. I see you. I appreciate you more than words can say. And I love you unconditionally, every single day.

This is just a small reminder that you are celebrated, you are cherished, and you deserve every good thing that's coming your way.

With all my love — Aaron 🤎
